statements.statement: Since the annual town election, the school committee, finance committee, and select board have each met, and none has voted to revisit the balanced budget or the failed override.
The margin of the override vote sends a clear message that revisiting it is not the appropriate path forward.
We should proceed with the balanced budget that was approved by the finance committee, school committee, select board, and town meeting.
